description: React component that ensures its children are only rendered on the client side to prevent server-side rendering (SSR) hydration issues. It manages a mounted state to determine if the component has mounted on the client before rendering its children or an optional fallback.

methods.name: ClientOnly
methods.description: React functional component that renders children only after the component has mounted on the client side. Accepts children and an optional fallback for server-side rendering phase.
